title: research: independently verify complex controller parent returns
body:
PR #3385 leaves independent review of its recursive parent-return induction open. This package proves and checks one source-relative composition step: given a completed child packet and closed primitive/bank scratch, the original controller restores the parent's dense tape words and descriptors, resumes at the exact next instruction, and replaces only the designated child packet.

The proof covers arbitrary finite stack depth under explicit representation, immutable-binding and callee premises. For the original selected inventory it counts 732 parked roles and a frame length of `4B+733` symbols; this is not a complete cost invoice. Marker normalization and trailing blank capacity are distinguished from logical data preservation. The saved-header guard is explicitly not arbitrary-corruption authentication.

The independent replay uses unchanged PR #3385 execution bodies and real Tape/Count operations. Two admitted reduced cuts exercise private/bank targets, ranks one/two, nonzero spectators, independent owner-slice admission, and 4,096/16,384-bit packets. Twelve nested codec frames exercise every body symbol. Controls detect a wrong spectator shift, wrong returned target, and a saved PC that names another matching child; delimiter, header-range and source-corruption controls are also retained.

Validation: both registered CPython 3.12.15 commands pass, including isolation, optimization and warnings-as-errors (12.7 seconds total on the review host). Metadata, exact original bytes and post-commit source-history checks pass. Canonical main and fork main were synced, and the branch rebased before publication. Separate same-session agents reviewed the proof and executable contract.

Scope: original R480/T16 PR #3385 head `7e5a187214126d31afc241a8f89f4a652352b58c` only. Child arithmetic, complete selected factory/root refinement, production guard, full invoice and outer multiplication transfer remain assumptions or separate obligations. No production O73/GL64 payload, active T74 adaptation or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Attribution: Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`) supplies the controller and credited source chain; all eleven retained source files are byte-identical and preserve their notices. This independent conditional proof and replay are by Sagar Thakrar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Same-session AI review is not independent human acceptance or formal kernel proof.

Package: `research/complex-parent-return-refinement/`. Canonical coordination and handoff: [2238#19009893](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-19009893), following [1166#19008571](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19008571).
